thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Production error rate spike detected in /v1/generate (gateway 5xx + timeouts) — p95 latency > 3s, 5xx rate 4.8% over last 2m. Auto-page: @aisha.oncall @sam.sre @marco.runtime

Aisha.oncall: I'm on it. seeing the paging alert. which region?

sam.sre: US-WEST primarily. metrics: per-shard queue depth rising, scheduler batcher backlog increasing. head-of-line delays on batcher-4.

marco.runtime: logs from batcher-4: repeated "enqueue timeout" and "kvcache miss growth". looks like large requests + long seq length.

li.ml: any recent model rollouts? model-catalog shows no new host traffic. but a canary of quantized-Llama2 was promoted last night to test cluster; not in prod though.

tess.support: Support reports customers A and B are seeing timeouts and 502s from our gateway. One customer raised a Sev2.

priya.prod: I'm going to start impact summary for execs. Can we confirm scope: is this a single cluster or cross-region?

sam.sre: It's localized to US-WEST compute pool. Gateway is routing to that pool heavily because of traffic shift. Cross-region failover hasn't kicked in yet because health checks still show nodes healthy but overloaded.

aisha.oncall: Immediate mitigation options?

marco.runtime: Short list: 1) enable emergency eviction on batcher-4 to clear H-O-L. 2) divert a % of traffic at gateway to US-EAST fallback models. 3) temporarily lower max_batch_size to reduce head-of-line wait. 4) throttle long-sequence requests using request-length-based rate limit.

sam.sre: I can enable eviction and lower batch size. Doing eviction now on batcher-4 -> running command: 
```
runtimectl evict --pool=batcher-4 --policy=preemptive --grace=2s
```

sam.sre: Eviction triggered. seeing backlog drop on shard 2. p95 latency improved slightly from 3.8s -> 2.9s. 5xx still ~3.6%

marco.runtime: Routing diversion next. I'll add a weighted route to send 20% of /v1/generate to us-east models to relieve pressure. Applying route patch: 
```
routingctl patch --route "/v1/generate" --add-backend us-east:0.2
```

marco.runtime: Route applied. traffic shift visible within 30s. error rate trending down to 2.1%

li.ml: Note: us-east model variant is smaller (fewer tokens/shorter KV cache). Might produce slightly different output; flag to clients.

tess.support: Notifying impacted customers with templated message. Ravi, can you join CSM channel to prepare direct outreach?

ravi.csm: joining. Drafting message: "We're aware of elevated 5xx/timeouts in US-WEST. We're routing traffic to reduce errors, you may see slightly different latency/outputs. We're prioritizing stability and will follow up with root cause."

aisha.oncall: Good. Sam, any other infra tweaks?

sam.sre: Lowering max_batch_ms from 25 -> 8 to reduce HOL wait. Command: 
```
batcherctl set --pool=batcher-* --max-batch-ms=8
```

sam.sre: Applied to pools. Immediate effect: average queue wait down, but throughput drops ~12% as more smaller batches go out. 5xx down to 1.4% and p95 ~1.6s.

marco.runtime: We're seeing some backend GPU pods OOM when eviction pushes more concurrent small requests. Scaling compute pool up by +3 nodes as a buffer. 

marco.runtime: Scaling command: 
```
infractl scale --pool=us-west-inference --add=3
```

marco.runtime: New instances are coming up; healthchecks show them joining. This should let us raise batch window back later.

li.ml: Collecting logs for suspicious request shapes. There's a spike in long-context streaming sessions from a single client token bucket. We should consider quiescing that client temporarily.

priya.prod: For postmortem note: timeline + mitigation steps captured. I'm creating a short incident summary and will escalate to incident review board after stabilization.

tess.support: Customers A & B acknowledged the message, appreciate the proactive reroute. No data leakage; all logs show errors at gateway.

sam.sre: Temporary rate-limit rule applied for sequences > 4k tokens for new sessions. Rule: 
```
ratelimitctl create --match "/v1/generate" --condition "token_count>4000" --limit 5r/m --scope=ip
```

sam.sre: Rule active. That cut down a lot of the pathological requests.

marco.runtime: Now that eviction + routing + batch-window + scale are in place, metrics: 5xx ~0.4%, p95 1.2s, queue depth back to baseline. Marking live mitigation successful.

aisha.oncall: Great. Keeping this thread open for 1hr for stability confirmation. Sam, Marco, can you keep watch and revert emergency changes slowly?

sam.sre: Will roll batch window to 15ms in 10m and remove eviction after 20m if stable.

marco.runtime: I'll remove the traffic diversion after 30m and bring routes back to normal unless we see regressions.

li.ml: I'll capture sample requests (anonymized) to feed into the ML eval team — to see whether model selection/kvcache config needs changes for long-context throughput.

priya.prod: Draft for execs: one-paragraph summary + customer impact list + mitigations (eviction, short-term routing, batch-window reduction, scaling, rate-limits). Sending for review in #product-ops.

tess.support: I'm logging ticket updates and will follow up with customers when we graduate from mitigations -> root-cause postmortem.

aisha.oncall: Thanks team. Closing paging for oncall rotation in 15m if stable. Incident owner: sam.sre for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: severity: elevated-error-rate (5xx/timeouts); status: mitigated -> monitoring; owner: sam.sre; incident_id: INC-2026-0486. To automatically generate postmortem, use: `incidentctl create --id=INC-2026-0486 --owner=sam.sre`

sam.sre: Creating postmortem now. Will include timelines, commands run, customer impact matrix, and long-term actions: - refine routing fallback thresholds - add intelligent batch sizing by request-length - improve kvcache eviction heuristics - add synthetic load tests for long-context patterns.

priya.prod: Noting follow-ups for PMs and customer success. Closing thread in 60m unless activity resumes.

ravi.csm: Customers are satisfied with communication so far. Will reopen for any escalations.

sam.sre: final check: metrics stable for 5m. moving to monitoring-only.

aisha.oncall: leaving shift now, handoff to next oncall @sam.sre. Good job everyone :thumbsup:
